title: 批次数与产量
objective: 聚合整张批次表，统计批次数和生产件数。
statement: 统计 batches 的批次数与生产件数合计，依次输出 batch_count、total_quantity；不按产线分组。空表时次数为 0、件数合计为 SQL NULL。
knowledge: COUNT(*) 统计批次记录数，SUM(quantity) 累加件数；一个批次算一条记录，产量多少另由 quantity 决定。
defect_rate 有 3 条 SQL NULL，因此 COUNT(defect_rate) 只得到 8 个已评估批次，不能用于统计全部批次。
没有 GROUP BY 时整表聚合一行。空表下 COUNT(*) 为 0，SUM(quantity) 为 NULL；quantity=0 仍是一条批次记录，只会给产量总和增加 0。
starterSql: -- 统计批次数量与生产数量合计。

hints.text: 要整张 batches 表的一个批次数和件数总和，不按 line_id 分组。
COUNT(*) 数批次记录，SUM(quantity) 加总生产件数；聚合结果可以并列输出。
SELECT COUNT(*) AS batch_count, ____ AS total_quantity FROM batches;

referenceSolutions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS batch_count, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM batches;
referenceSolutions.explanation: COUNT(*) 统计 11 条批次记录，SUM(quantity) 将这些批次的件数相加。整表聚合不分组；空表计数为 0、总量为 NULL。

expectedFailures.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS batch_count, AVG(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM batches;
SELECT COUNT(defect_rate) AS batch_count, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM batches;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS batch_count, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM batches GROUP BY line_id;
